title: FAA UAP reports, batch 11 (237UAP00261 - 237UAP00285)
doc_notes: This document is a batch of FAA Skywatch incident reports; it contains three reports of close-range encounters with objects, while the remainder are distant light sightings.

encounters.summary: A ground observer reported a stationary bright light with a low sphere shape and surrounding lights near TRK airport for 30 minutes.
encounters.entity_appearance: bright light with a low sphere shape and lights surrounding it
encounters.quote: ground observation of a very bright light with a low sphere shape

encounters.summary: A pilot reported a near miss with a white cylindrical object the size of three bowling balls at FL 190.
encounters.entity_appearance: white cylindrical shape, approximately size of three bowling balls
encounters.quote: white cylindrical shape, approximately size of three bowling balls

encounters.summary: A pilot reported a brown, stationary object the size of a Volkswagen 200 feet below their aircraft.
encounters.entity_appearance: brown, stationary object the size of a Volkswagon
encounters.quote: brown, stationary object the size of a Volkswagon
